---
title: "NBA Scorigami"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  error: false
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(grid)

games <- read.csv("Games.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

games <- games |>
  mutate(
    gameDate = as.Date(gameDateTimeEst),
    year = year(gameDate),
    homeScore = as.integer(homeScore),
    awayScore = as.integer(awayScore)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(homeScore), !is.na(awayScore))

score_grid <- games |>
  filter(homeScore >= 16, homeScore <= 192,
         awayScore >= 16, awayScore <= 192)

score_trend <- games |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(unique_scores = n_distinct(paste(homeScore, awayScore, sep = "-")), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(cumulative = cumsum(unique_scores))

total_scores <- n_distinct(paste(score_grid$homeScore, score_grid$awayScore, sep = "-"))
year_label <- sprintf("%d - %d", min(score_trend$year), max(score_trend$year))

p_main <- ggplot(score_grid, aes(x = homeScore, y = awayScore)) +
  stat_bin2d(binwidth = c(4, 4), colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#120A31", "#373179", "#5c52a6", "#c67047", "#fecb78", "#fdf1c7"),
    values = rescale(c(0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.6, 0.85, 1)),
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 12, barheight = 0.5, title = "Density")
  ) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "white", size = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(20, 192, by = 20), limits = c(16, 192)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(20, 192, by = 20), limits = c(16, 192)) +
  labs(
    x = "Home PTS",
    y = "Visitor PTS",
    title = "NBA Scorigami",
    subtitle = "A heatmap of NBA game scores from Games.csv",
    caption = "Data: Games.csv"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f5f5f8", colour = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f5f5f8", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#d9d9e0"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "#3c3f56"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "#3c3f56", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold", colour = "#1f2648"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, colour = "#4b5172"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, colour = "#6c6f85"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

p_trend <- ggplot(score_trend, aes(x = year, y = cumulative)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#4b5da9", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_line(colour = "#2d3a7b", size = 0.8) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(score_trend$year), max(score_trend$year), by = 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eef0f6", colour = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#eef0f6", colour = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, colour = "#4a4d62"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "#d0d4df"),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "#d0d4df"),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )

trend_grob <- ggplotGrob(p_trend)

p_main +
  annotation_custom(
    grob = trend_grob,
    xmin = 18,
    xmax = 80,
    ymin = 166,
    ymax = 192
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 23,
    y = 162,
    label = paste0("Unique Scores\n", formatC(total_scores, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
                   "\nYears\n", year_label),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 5,
    colour = "#212843",
    fontface = "bold"
  )
```
